query: 书里那套实时振动分析器一共有几种工作模式？要先跑哪个模式、它做什么？监测模式下靠什么判据判断机器健康状态？把整个流程串起来讲一遍。
source_id: 精密运动控制设计与实现
gold_standard: 分析器有三种模式：学习（learning）、监测（monitoring）、诊断（diagnostic）。流程：先运行学习模式——机器正常工况下由加速度计采集振动信号并存入 DSP 模块，从中提取振动签名（可用基于频谱的签名，FFT 高效获得）；监测模式——机器正常闭环运行、不注入任何额外信号，周期性采样振动信号，将实时频谱与对应振动签名对比（判据如 EV1：实时频谱与签名的均方差 EV1=Σ(Sq−Sq*)²/N；EV2：时序振动模式最高幅值之差 max(Tq)−max(Tq*)），多判据经模糊融合得到 HEALTH∈[0,1]，HEALTH≤γ（阈值 γ 通常取 0.6≤γ≤0.9）时触发报警，否则继续监测；诊断模式则需向机器施加显式输入信号（如正弦、方波、chirp）再对照相应签名分析。检索链：先查 7.3 节三种模式定义，再查 7.3.1 学习模式做什么，再查 7.3.2 监测模式判据与 HEALTH 决策。
success_criteria: 答出三种模式名称及先后顺序（学习模式先行）、学习模式提取振动签名、监测模式不注入额外信号且给出 EV 判据（均方差/幅值差）与 HEALTH 阈值触发报警的逻辑。
evidence: --[p222]-- The vibration analyser can operate in three modes: learning, monitoring or diagnostic mode. --[p222]-- The learning mode, to be initiated first, will yield a set of vibration signatures based on which the monitoring and diagnostic modes can operate. In the monitoring mode, with the machine under normal closed-loop control, the analyser only uses the naturally occuring vibration signal to deduce the condition of the machine. No deliberate and additional signal is input to the machine. --[p224]-- In the learning mode, the vibration signals, with the machine operating under normal conditions, are acquired by the accelerometer and stored in the DSP module. A suitable vibration signature (Ramirez 1985) is then extracted from the vibration signals. --[p226]-- one evaluation criterion (EV) may be based on the mean-square (ms) value of the error (Ramirez 1985) between the current real-time vibration spectrum and the vibration signature: $$ \mathtt { E V } _ { 1 } = \frac { \sum _ { q = 1 } ^ { N } ( S _ { q } - S _ { q } ^ { * } ) ^ { 2 } } { N } ,\tag{7.18} $$ --[p228]-- $\gamma$ can be seen as a threshold value. Suitable values for $\gamma$ may be in the range $0 . 6 \leq \gamma \leq 0 . 9$
